contexts.text: If anyone lives where there are... no sacraments...

They place the essential of worship in this: that... they observe the sacraments... Those who make worship from love and charity essential, in like manner... observe the sacraments... but do not place the essential of worship in them.
A sacred obligation. Signified.
Let there be an oath between us () = the consensus of doctrinals with the literal sense of the Word.
The sacrament of baptism and the Holy Supper (is equally holy when performed by an evil man).
As (the Quakers) have rejected the two sacraments... no Society is formed of them in the Spiritual World...
Preface. VII. On the seven sacraments (of the Roman Catholics). Extracts.
That baptism is holy and a sacrament...
(In their) use of the sacraments... there is a Trinity of gods.
That without a Knowledge of the spiritual sense... no one can know what the two sacraments... involve and effect. General article.
Yet these two sacraments, regarded in the spiritual sense, are the most holy things of worship.
The two sacraments... are, in the Christian Church, like two jewels in a king's sceptre: if the uses of them are not known, they are like two forms of ebony on a staff. (Other comparisons made.)

It has pleased the Lord to reveal the spiritual sense... in order that this New Church may come into the use and enjoyment itself of the sacraments... which takes place when they see with their... understandings the holiness which lies hidden therein, and apply this to themselves through the means which the Lord has taught in His Word.
The holiness of this sacrament... without the opening of the spiritual sense... cannot be spiritually acknowledged. (Described by comparisons.)
These two sacraments... are like two gates to eternal life. Explained.
Otherwise, ... the sacraments, etc., effect nothing: they rather confirm the man... that his sins are remitted... and so he returns to his previous filth.
This (communion of wives) is their sacrament of the Supper.
As (the Quakers) reject the sacraments...

On the sacrament of the Supper... among the Papists. (The separation of the wine from the bread, has not been done on account of a lack of wine) but it was from the Divine Providence... because good is not good if separated from truth.
(The Exhortation before) the sacrament of the Supper. (Quoted in English.)
If a man... go to the sacrament of the Supper frequently every year... and his internal has not been purified from (evils), it is a hypocritical work.
That which the Lord teaches about the sacraments.
Hence it is that the two sacraments are correspondences of spiritual things with natural ones. Hence their power. Inv 59:end.
